title: Products used by Tyndale
creator_name: Tyndale (Product Hunt product; JSON-LD author Pedro Mendes)
date_basis: The independent Built with page has no publication timestamp; the parent Tyndale product JSON-LD exposes datePublished 2026-04-23, which is product metadata and is not asserted as the page publication date.
summary: Product Hunt 的 Tyndale 独立 Built with 页面展示其产品定位、技术栈和 Pi 采用说明：页面列出 GitHub 上的 badlogic/pi-mono，并保留一条可见的 Pi 体验引用，称其 harness 简洁、支持多个 provider。
why_useful: 这是一个可回读的 Product Hunt 采用快照，说明独立产品团队如何把 Pi 作为多 provider 的 coding-agent harness 纳入技术栈；可用于研究 Pi 的生态扩散与产品化信号，但不能替代 Pi-primary 教程或性能证据。
discovery_backend: ordinary public Google exact-phrase discovery (site:producthunt.com/products/ "Pi provides a clean and easy harness") followed by direct canonical lookup
readback_backend: ordinary user-visible Product Hunt canonical Built with page in Chrome
limitations: Pi 是 Tyndale 技术栈中的 secondary adoption 项，不是 Pi-primary 内容；页面中的体验引用未显示独立署名，且 Product Hunt 的栈、评分、关注数和引用均可变。页面未提供 Pi 版本、配置、代码或受控 benchmark；本条只保存短摘要与可观察事实，未登录、未投票、未评论、未关注、未下载，也未使用 HTML 爬虫或 API token。是否计入 Product Hunt 配额须由主策展人按 secondary adoption 口径决定。
readback_evidence: 匿名 Chrome 直接打开 https://www.producthunt.com/products/tyndale/built-with，页面标题为 Products used by Tyndale | Product Hunt；可见 Tyndale、tagline "Translate your app with the AI you already pay for"、60 followers、产品描述、Built with 导航和完整技术栈区块。正文明确列出 GitHub 项 "GitHub - badlogic/pi-mono: AI agent toolkit: coding agent CLI, unified LLM API, TUI & web UI libraries, Slack bot, vLLM pods"、5.0 (1 review)，以及引用 "Pi provides a clean and easy harness with multiple providers accepted. It's freedom and power at our hands"；同页可见 Tyndale 网站/GitHub、Launched in 2026、Forum p/tyndale。link[rel=canonical] 与 meta[property=og:url] 均为 https://www.producthunt.com/products/tyndale/built-with；JSON-LD 为独立 Tyndale WebApplication（author Pedro Mendes，datePublished 2026-04-23，dateModified 2026-08-23）。页面正文与 Pi 卡片均在原生页面可见，未使用搜索摘要作最终证据。
readback_observation: Full visible Product Hunt Built with page read in ordinary Chrome; canonical and og:url matched the supplied URL. The independent Tyndale product header, description, Pi/badlogic repository card, visible Pi adoption quote, and parent product metadata were all observed.
